items.title: Drake Sued Over ‘Janice STFU’ by Producer Who Says Rapper Stole His Chorus
items.summary: Drake is being sued for copyright infringement on his hit “Janice STFU” by a producer who says the rapper and his team “shamelessly refuse to acknowledge” his substantial contributions. Drake has been hit with a copyright infringement lawsuit over his hit song “Janice STFU” by a producer named Aviel Calev Hirschfield,…

items.title: Elephant In the Room Reminder: Major Hits from Kylie Minogue and Nick Cave Already Used to Train AI Without Compensation, the ICMP Tells Australian Legislators
items.summary: The global trade body ICMP warns that AI training may lead to the dilution of Australian copyright laws, effectively “legitimizing larceny.” The International Confederation of Music Publishers (ICMP) has cautioned the Australian government against giving in to efforts from tech companies seeking to weaken copyright law…

items.title: Labels’ fail in bid to get Supreme Court to overturn termination-rights ruling
items.summary: The three major labels and BMG have failed in their bid to get the US Supreme Court to overturn a ruling that artists can exert their ‘termination rights’ to regain their copyrights globally, not just in the US. The post is from Music Ally .

RIAA Flags Anna’s Archive and AI Voice Cloner to U.S. Government
items.summary: The RIAA has submitted its latest overview of "notorious markets" to the U.S. Government. It lists familiar names such as The Pirate Bay and Rapidgator, but the music group also flags shadow library Anna's Archive and AI voice-cloning service Lalals. items.summary: American Federation of Musicians asking major labels to give artists a contract with AI protections and compensation

items.title: Un músico, condenado a prisión por utilizar "bots" de inteligencia artificial para cobrar millones en derechos de autor
Musixmatch acquires Songdex and Blokur owner Music Reports
items.summary: Lyrics firm Musixmatch was founded 16 years ago, but has never bought another company… until now. It has announced the acquisition of Music Reports, the US firm that owns the Songdex copyright registry as well as rights and licensing firm Blokur. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: Universal Music appoints first AI director amid copyright lawsuits
Spotify Removes 75 Million Songs Identified as ‘AI-Generated Slop or Spam’
items.summary: The streaming service cut the slop tracks in favor of “more music made by authentic, human artists,” with 50 million more being filtered from recommendations made to listeners

tip.title: Antes de firmar, revisa la reversión de derechos
tip.body: La pregunta clave de cualquier contrato no es cuánto te dan hoy, sino cuándo y cómo recuperas tu obra. Si no hay cláusula de reversión, estás cediendo por el plazo completo.

tip.title: Before signing, check the reversion clause
tip.body: The key question in any deal isn't what you get today —it's when and how you get your work back. With no reversion clause, you're assigning for the full term.
